text:
Sex can speed the whole thing up enough by itself. I don’t want to also move in immediately and let that answer a bunch of questions I haven’t answered yet. Sometimes housing makes separate living unrealistic. Fine. But once we share a home, now there are practical reasons to stay even if one of us is having doubts. That’s why I like having a date on the calendar when we actually ask how it’s going instead of waiting for a crisis.

I also want some friends who know both of us. My old friends are going to be partial to me and hers to her. That isn’t a defect in the friendship. It just means I don’t want two separate cheering sections to be the only people around the relationship.
